lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: That was too close. An Inquisitor doesn't chase skaa thieves for sport — someone in that keep knew we were coming.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: The ledger will tell us who.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: It will. Rest tonight. Tomorrow, we make sure you can survive a lot more than a rooftop chase.
